'''Alexander Mevissen''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2001 Munich tournament]] on 17 March 2001 with Kirdo3 Ops, according to Quirin Fürgut's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1916">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-19-munich-ralltiir-3-17-01d1916/ munich-ralltiir-3-17-01], DeckTech (Quirin "el-diablo" Fuergut, 19 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-19-munich-ralltiir-3-17-01d1916/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
